title: The inherited rank-42 route has suffix seed sets, not a Hall assignment
mathematical_status: proved model correction and exact next-lemma isolation

repository_definition_audit.result: No inherited token-to-rank bipartite graph, distinct-rank assignment, rank-slot capacity vector, or Hall condition is defined. The word 'legal row' means a row where the single canonical orbit/chart remains nonnegative and its displayed recurrence is valid.
repository_definition_audit.actual_object: For each ambient parameter M, two adjacent scalar Macaulay orbits f^M and f^(M+1) define one diagonal surplus Gamma_r(M)=g_(r+1)-S_r(f_r) at every legal row r. Different M are independent proof parameters and are not competing for a shared rank resource.

suffix_interval_theorem.definition: N(M)={r: 1<=r<=M-42, row r is legal and Gamma_r(M)>=0}.
suffix_interval_theorem.statement: Within the legal-row domain, N(M) is empty or a suffix interval. If p=min N(M), then every later legal r<=M-42 also lies in N(M).
suffix_interval_theorem.proof: This is exactly the inherited one-positive-seed persistence lemma: Gamma_r>=0 and M+221>=r+2 imply Gamma_(r+1)>=0. The side inequality is automatic for r<=M-42. Induction gives the suffix property.
suffix_interval_theorem.capacity_interpretation: There is one unit existence demand for each M and no shared right-side capacity. Thus the artificial Hall system collapses to the scalar condition N(M) nonempty; no proper-subset Hall cuts remain.

compressed_potential.one_dimensional_state: sigma(M)=min N(M), with sigma(M)=infinity when N(M) is empty.
compressed_potential.equivalent_endpoint_form: By persistence, proving sigma(M)<infinity before M-42 is equivalent to producing one r<=M-42 with Gamma_r(M)>=0; after this point the endpoint capacity follows.
compressed_potential.dyadic_coordinates: On A_(j-1)<M<=A_j, write M=A_(j-1)+b. The exact low-tail localization gives Gamma_(j+p-2)(M)=gamma_p(L,b). The genuine adaptive potential is therefore the first nonnegative low-tail rank p_*(L,b), not a neighbourhood profile kappa(X).

why_uniform_relaxed_gamma4_does_not_yet_.proved_relaxed_fact: Every sufficiently large admissible no-borrow tuple (q,c,r,u) has gamma4>0 uniformly in c>=2.
why_uniform_relaxed_gamma4_does_not_yet_.missing_exact_map: It is not proved that every unresolved actual dyadic low tail gamma_p(L,b)<0, after its next normalization, lands in the admissible relaxed no-borrow coordinates with the same surplus and with all borrow/cap legality preserved.
why_uniform_relaxed_gamma4_does_not_yet_.no_borrow_is_not_enough: The actual orbit can cross x-only, y-only, both, or later multiple canonical walls. Existing chamber theorems close many such transitions, but there is no exhaustion theorem routing every positive-side first unresolved wall either to an already closed chamber or to the uniform relaxed gamma4 theorem.
why_uniform_relaxed_gamma4_does_not_yet_.conclusion: The exact bridge gap is phase exhaustiveness/transition identification, not Hall expansion.

exact_next_lemma.name: Actual-orbit coverage by closed chambers
exact_next_lemma.statement: For every dyadic strip A_(j-1)<M<=A_j and every first unresolved legal low-tail row gamma_p(L,b)<0 before M-42, the exact next Macaulay normalization satisfies one of: (i) an already proved borrow/cap recovery chamber; (ii) an admissible relaxed no-borrow tuple (q,c,r,u) with c>=2 whose gamma4 equals the next actual diagonal surplus Gamma_(j+p-1)(M); or (iii) a finite explicit exceptional base. All parameter maps, parity/range conditions, wall counts, and cap legality must be displayed.
exact_next_lemma.closure_effect: Together with the audited uniform relaxed gamma4 theorem and the inherited chamber results, this gives N(M) nonempty for every M, hence the rank-42 capacity gate by suffix persistence.
exact_next_lemma.first_kill_test: Extract every actual first-wall transition for bounded dyadic strips without using the relaxed-state generator. For each row, solve the proposed (q,c,r,u) map and record failures of parity, remainder ranges, x>=0, surplus equality, or single-wall exhaustiveness. One failure is a genuine crossing-neighbourhood counterexample to the coverage lemma.

bounded_guard.result: pass; for every 67<=M<=160 the exact seed set is a nonempty suffix, with first seed rank 3 or 4
bounded_guard.scope: independent exact Macaulay implementation; verifies nonempty suffix seed sets for 67<=M<=160 only

correction_to_prior_evidence: BORROW_AWARE_CAPACITY_FLOW.json is retained as a generic information-loss illustration, but its Hall graph is not an inherited #776 object. It must not be treated as the exact public bridge.
